title: The Vespérine Manor
tagline: A séance gone wrong. Midnight is coming.
intro: October 1899. At the Vespérine manor, the medium Irène gathered her guests for a séance. At the third question, the table rose and every flame turned blue.
Since then, the clocks run backwards and something walks the corridors. If the spirit is not sent back before midnight, it will keep the house, and everyone in it.
Each of you searches a different room of the manor. Put together, your memories will give its name.
ending: You speak the name aloud. One by one, the flames turn yellow again. Far off, the clock strikes midnight, the right way round this time.
In Héloïse's diary, one last line appears, in an unknown hand: “Thank you.”
failEnding: Midnight strikes. The twelve chimes ring on far too long.
In the morning, the servants find the drawing room door locked from the inside. Try again.

A magnifying glass with an ivory handle.

zones.name: The great drawing room

hotspots.label: in the ashes of the hearth

flavor: A spilled glass of port, sticky.

zones.name: The study

hotspots.label: the false bottom of the drawer

flavor: A goose quill, its nib split.
A wax seal with an owl motif.
A candle invoice: three hundred, delivered on 2 October.

zones.name: Irène's bedroom
flavor: A bottle of laudanum, its stopper sealed with wax.
A lock of blond hair tied with a ribbon.
The music box plays three notes, then falls silent.

zones.name: The dining room
flavor: One place too many was laid: fourteen for thirteen guests.
An overturned salt cellar. No one threw salt over their shoulder.
A menu: “Sorrel soup, pheasant, pears in wine”.
